function.name: get_status
function.description: Fetch global controller status, software rain delay, physical rain sensor state, hardware sensor states (sensor 1 & 2), and current running status for all stations.

function.name: get_programs
function.description: Fetch a list of all configured watering programs, including their 1-based IDs, names, and whether they are currently enabled.

function.name: get_options
function.description: Fetch system diagnostics and settings. Use this tool to find the current Watering Level (weather adjustment percentage), whether weather adjustments are enabled, firmware/hardware versions, and sunrise/sunset times.

function.name: set_station
function.description: Manually open or close a single sprinkler station.

station_id.description: The 1-based ID of the station to control (1-72).

state.description: true to turn ON, false to turn OFF.

duration.description: Duration in seconds. Required if state is true.

function.name: start_program
function.description: Manually trigger a pre-configured schedule/program by its ID.

program_id.description: 1-based index of the program to run.

use_weather.description: Apply weather adjustment percentage. Default is true.

function.name: run_once
function.description: Run a custom sequence of multiple stations manually.

station_durations.description: A dictionary mapping 1-based Station IDs (as strings) to durations in seconds. Example: {"1": 600, "3": 300} will run Station 1 for 10 mins, then Station 3 for 5 mins.

function.name: set_rain_delay
function.description: Enable or disable a temporary rain delay.

hours.description: Number of hours to delay. Set to 0 to cancel an active rain delay.

function.name: pause_queue
function.description: Temporarily pause all currently running and queued watering programs for a specified number of seconds.

duration_seconds.description: Number of seconds to pause (e.g., 600 for 10 minutes). Set to 0 to cancel an active pause.

function.name: set_operation
function.description: Toggle global operation mode (enable or disable automatic watering).

enable.description: true to enable system operations, false to disable.

function.name: stop_all_stations
function.description: Immediately aborts all currently running programs and stations.

function.name: get_logs
function.description: Fetch historical watering records and sensor triggers.

hist_days.description: Number of historical days to fetch (e.g., 1 to 30).

function.name: reboot_controller
function.description: Send a remote reboot signal to the hardware unit.
